# documentation-actions

> Reusable GitHub Actions and workflows for Docusaurus docs sites and awesome-list repositories.
> Optimized for AI coding agents.

## Quick decision tree (agents)

| Goal | Prefer | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| Full docs CI | examples/docs-ci.yml | reusable-docs-ci |
| PR build only | examples/test-deploy.yml | reusable-test-deploy (alias) |
| Pages deploy | examples/deploy-pages.yml | reusable-pages-deploy (alias) |
| Link check | examples/link-check.yml | |
| Awesome list | examples/awesome-list-checks.yml | |
| Changelog / index / catalog | matching examples/ | secrets: inherit |
| Auto-rebase | examples/auto-rebase-prs.yml | |
| Star thank-you | examples/star-request.yml | pull_request_target |
| Label conflicts | examples/label-conflicted-prs.yml | reusable-label-conflicts (alias) |
| PR report | examples/pr-status-report.yml | reusable-pr-report (alias) |
| README sync | examples/readme-docs-sync-check.yml | reusable-readme-sync (alias) |
| README-only comment | examples/comment-readme-only.yml | reusable-readme-only (alias) |

## Core rules

1. Copy from examples/.
2. Pin third-party Actions to full SHA.
3. Triggers + permissions stay on the caller.
4. Append-only index.
5. Changelog fragments only.
6. Line length ≤ 140.
7. Prefer short-name aliases when they exist.
8. Do not merge unless asked.
